opportunities.title: Senior Principal ASIC Design Engineer
opportunities.description:
Astera Labs (NASDAQ: ALAB) provides rack-scale AI infrastructure through purpose-built connectivity solutions. By collaborating with hyperscalers and ecosystem partners, Astera Labs enables organizations to unlock the full potential of modern AI. Astera Labs’ Intelligent Connectivity Platform integrates CXL®, Ethernet, NVLink, PCIe®, and UALink™ semiconductor-based technologies with the company’s COSMOS software suite to unify diverse components into cohesive, flexible systems that deliver end-to-end scale-up, and scale-out connectivity. The company’s custom connectivity solutions business complements its standards-based portfolio, enabling customers to deploy tailored architectures to meet their unique infrastructure requirements. Discover more at www.asteralabs.com.

Senior Principal ASIC Design Engineer

Location: Germany (on-site)

Role Overview

Astera Labs is building purpose-built silicon for rack-scale AI infrastructure. As a Distinguished Engineer, you will be a senior technical leader driving ASIC design for next-generation Ethernet and Scale-Up (ESUN) connectivity products.

You will set technical direction across the full ASIC design flow, spanning high-speed Ethernet, UALink, UCIe, and PCIe Gen 6/7. You will solve complex scale-up networking challenges, mentor senior engineers, and turn ambitious product goals into robust, manufacturable silicon.

Technical Leadership & Architecture

  • Define and drive ASIC architecture for Ethernet/ESUN connectivity products across UALink, UCIe, PCIe Gen 6/7, and Ethernet.
  • Lead architecture and microarchitecture for high-performance Ethernet controllers, MACs, NIC datapaths, packet processing pipelines, and AI interconnect fabrics.
  • Define scalable, low-latency, high-bandwidth data movement, scheduling, buffering, congestion management, QoS, reliability, and flow control.
  • Architect hardware acceleration for NIC functions, RDMA, DMA, virtualization, and protocol offloads.
  • Lead tradeoff analysis across performance, power, area, latency, scalability, resiliency, and programmability.
  • Serve as a technical authority across digital, networking, and system domains.

ASIC Design & Execution

  • Lead RTL design and microarchitecture development for Ethernet controllers, MACs, NIC datapaths, protocol engines, and AI networking subsystems.
  • Design packet processing architectures, DMA engines, queue management, scheduling, buffering, and memory subsystem interfaces.
  • Develop hardware mechanisms for RDMA, zero-copy data movement, congestion control, transport reliability, and protocol acceleration.
  • Design scalable architectures supporting virtualization, multi-tenant isolation, traffic management, and quality of service.
  • Partner with firmware and software teams to define hardware/software interfaces for initialization, management, telemetry, performance monitoring, and diagnostics.
  • Drive execution from architecture through RTL, integration, verification, tapeout, and post-silicon bring-up.
  • Partner cross-functionally to meet performance, timing, power, area, manufacturability, and reliability targets.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
  • 12+ years of ASIC/SoC design experience, with a track record of delivering complex, high-speed networking or connectivity silicon from architecture through production.
  • Deep expertise in RTL design and microarchitecture for high-performance networking and connectivity ASICs.
  • Extensive experience designing Ethernet controllers, MACs, NIC architectures, packet processing engines, or network interface subsystems.
  • Strong understanding of RDMA architectures and transport protocols such as RoCE, InfiniBand concepts, or similar low-latency networking technologies.
  • Experience designing hardware for packet parsing, scheduling, buffering, DMA, queue management, flow control, congestion management, and transport acceleration.
  • Strong understanding of high-speed interconnects and protocols, including Ethernet, PCIe, and AI scale-up fabrics.
  • Hands-on experience across the complete ASIC development flow, including architecture, RTL design, integration, synthesis, timing closure, physical implementation, tapeout, and post-silicon validation.
  • Demonstrated technical leadership across multiple teams and product programs.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s or PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Direct experience with UALink, UCIe, PCIe Gen 6/7, and/or advanced Ethernet architectures and protocols.
  • Experience designing Ethernet MACs, controllers, SmartNICs, DPUs, NICs, switch datapaths, or packet processing engines.
  • Experience developing Ethernet-based scale-up networking solutions for AI and HPC systems.
  • Experience leading architecture or design for multiple successful advanced-node ASIC tapeouts.
  • Excellent communication, collaboration, and mentorship skills.

 

We know that creativity and innovation happen more often when teams include diverse ideas, backgrounds, and experiences, and we actively encourage everyone with relevant experience to apply, including people of color, LGBTQ+ and non-binary people, veterans, parents, and individuals with disabilities.

opportunities.description: THE JOB Reading this to the end is worth it. The Company: Why mute-labs? mute-labs is the EU market leader in acoustic phone booths, with more than 20,000 cabins sold and counting. We are self-funded, profitable since day one, and have no investors to answer to and no exit to chase. What we do have is a steep growth curve in revenue, a product made in Germany, and a genuine mission: giving the modern office some quiet back. We have built a strong direct and dealer business on the back of inbound demand and word of mouth. What we have not built yet is a real outbound engine for winning bigger accounts on purpose, from ambitious growth companies to household names like Volkswagen, adidas, IKEA, Red Bull, or Axel Springer, who already trust us today. That gap is this role, and how far into that world you grow is largely up to you. Outbound is not a new idea for us. We have piloted it in smaller pockets already, testing signal-based outreach and structured sequences with real results. What has been missing is someone to own this as a dedicated motion for bigger accounts rather than a side project squeezed in between other things. That is why we are building this out as a new department and you’d be joining a small, yet focussed team as one of the first hires. The Role: Build the Pipeline AND the Channel This is a founding position. You are not stepping into an existing sales org with a quota handed down from three reps before you. You are the first one in the building. What you build, and how you build it, is largely up to you and your team, and you can grow the size and ambition of your target accounts as you find your footing. Green Field, Full Ownership: Build your own pipeline from scratch. There is no inherited book of business and no recycled leads. The customer base you build is yours, and so is the revenue you generate from it. Your Stack, Your Sequences: Clay, Reply.io, LinkedIn Premium, and Aircall are all at your disposal. You design your own outreach sequences, run your own cold calling campaigns, and decide how the machine works. Nobody hands you a script. Segment Strategy, Together: You understand the market as well as anyone. Rather than being handed a target list from above, you and your manager will decide together which segments and account types are worth focusing on. Comp That Rewards More Than the First Deal: An uncapped bonus with a kicker for overperformance. Returning customers you bring in keep feeding your comp over time, not just the initial close. Landing an account well is worth more than landing it once. A Brand That Opens Doors: You are not cold-calling on behalf of an unknown startup. mute-labs is an established, well-regarded market leader with a reference list that already includes some of the biggest names in German and European business. That credibility is yours to use from day one. A seasoned team to back you up: Your manager has built and run outbound and enterprise sales hands-on, from cold pipeline to six-figure closes, and will work closely with you from day one, coaching, supporting, and training wherever it's actually needed rather than just checking in on numbers. Is This You? The Go-Getter: You do not wait to be told what to do next. You get on your feet quickly, figure out the shape of the problem, and start moving before anyone has to push you. Sales Experience: You have carried a full sales cycle before, from first contact to signed contract, and know how to keep a deal moving without needing someone else to close it for you. You do not need to have sold into large enterprises already, that is something you will grow into here. Stakeholder Management: You know how to work a deal with more than one person in the room, decision-makers, influencers, and budget holders, and you can keep several of those relationships moving in parallel without losing the thread. Comfortable with Ambiguity: There is no existing playbook to inherit here. You will help write it. If you need every process defined for you before you can start, this is not the role. Fluent in German and English: Most of your target accounts are DACH-based, though the reference list extends across the EU. Strong German is expected; English is the internal working language. Our Hiring Process We keep this fast and honest, on both sides. The Spark: A short intro call with our People team to check for basic fit. The deepdive: A conversation with your future manager Patrick about your experience, how you build your pipeline and how you close. Here you’ll also meet the rest of the team. The Live Action: A live discovery or negotiation role-play based on a realistic enterprise scenario. No prep deck, just show us how you actually work a deal. The Vision: A final conversation with Leah, Head of Sales as well as Franziskus, Managing Director, on the strategic mandate behind this role and where it can go from here. ABOUT US mute-labs exists to make quiet a normal part of the modern workplace. A few things that set us apart: We are "no tech" : we build and sell real hardware, sound-insulated phone and meeting booths that companies actually need. We have no investors , and we are not looking for any. We have been profitable since day one. We are on a steep growth curve , measured in revenue and profit, not headcount for its own sake. We are not building toward an exit . We are building a company meant to last for generations. Skip the Queue Told you it was worth reading to the end. Committed to accelerating decarbonization and transforming the material life cycle, we’re actively crafting sustainable recycling solutions for a cleaner and more innovative future. WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR We are looking for a Senior Process Engineer to take a leading technical role in the design, scale-up, commissioning and ramp up of our battery recycling processes. This role sits at the intersection of technology development, process engineering, and industrial scale-up. You will translate experimental and operational data into robust process designs, challenge engineering assumptions, and ensure that our future plants are built on solid fundamentals. Your focus will be on the processes that matter most to our technology — graphite and lithium extraction. By working closely with R&D, Operations and external engineering partners, you will actively lead and engage in activities associated with: a) engineering design; b) commissioning and ramp up; c) process development. We are looking for someone who is comfortable working in a production environment, but who can also take a step back and understand what the data is telling us, and engineer the process we need at different scales. WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT Must Have's: 1. Future Plant Design & Scale-up ● Own key process design activities for our next-generation plants. ● Develop and review PFDs, P&IDs, mass and energy balances, process descriptions and equipment specifications for future capacity expansions. ● Translate pilot and industrial operating data into reliable engineering design criteria and scale-up assumptions. ● Perform process calculations and equipment sizing to ensure our future plants are designed based on validated engineering data rather than theoretical assumptions alone. 2. Targeted Process Expertise & Optimization ● Become a technical reference for some of our most critical process steps. ● Apply strong chemical engineering fundamentals to the optimization of graphite and lithium extraction and post-processing. ● Identify the parameters controlling yield, purity and process stability and translate these insights into concrete process improvements. ● Work closely with R&D and Operations while maintaining a strong focus on process performance and technology development rather than daily troubleshooting. 3. Data Analysis & Process Modeling ● Turn plant data into engineering decisions. ● Evaluate operational and experimental data, build and validate mass balances and process models, and identify gaps between expected and actual process performance. ● Define what data needs to be collected to support future scale-up decisions. ● Technically guide data analysts and other engineering functions to ensure that models and analytics remain grounded in physical and chemical reality. ● Translate analysis into clear recommendations for process upgrades and future plant designs. 4. Commissioning & Process Validation ● Make sure what we designed actually works. ● Participate in FATs/SATs, commissioning activities and process performance validation for new equipment and plant expansions. ● Develop acceptance and process validation criteria based on the original design intent. ● Evaluate commissioning and operational data to confirm that installed systems achieve their calculated performance targets. ● Work closely with Operations during handover while ensuring clear ownership transfers once the process meets its design criteria. 5. Operational Readiness, Process Safety & SOPs ● Design processes that can be operated safely and consistently. ● Translate process design and engineering intent into clear Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), operating envelopes and process documentation. ● Participate actively in HAZOPs, LOPAs, and other process safety reviews, ensuring that process risks are identified and addressed during design rather than after installation. ● Support Operations in understanding the design basis and critical process parameters of newly commissioned systems. Nice-to-have's: Vendor & EPC Coordination ● Represent tozero's process requirements with external engineering partners and equipment suppliers. ● Prepare and review technical specifications, vendor proposals and engineering documentation. ● Challenge unsupported assumptions, identify over-engineered solutions and ensure equipment is correctly sized for our process. ● Support technical bid evaluations and equipment selection, balancing process performance, CAPEX, operability and scalability. ● Act as a strong technical counterpart to EPCs, engineering contractors and equipment vendors throughout project execution. Your profile You have a strong chemical/process engineering foundation and enjoy solving technically complex problems with a combination of first-principles engineering and real plant data. ● Degree in Chemical Engineering, Process Engineering, Metallurgical Engineering or a related technical field. ● Ideally 5+ years of experience in process engineering within the chemical, hydrometallurgy, battery, mining, minerals, recycling or related process industries; specific expertise in graphite and lithium extraction and post-processing is highly preferred. ● Strong experience with process design and scale-up, including PFDs, P&IDs, mass/energy balances and equipment sizing. ● Comfortable working with industrial datasets and translating operational data into engineering models and decisions. ● Experience with solid-liquid separation, precipitation, flotation, hydrometallurgy or mineral processing is highly valuable. ● Able to critically review vendor proposals and confidently challenge technical assumptions. ● Strong experience supporting commissioning and process validation of industrial equipment or plants. ● Familiarity with process safety methodologies such as HAZOP and LOPA. ● Comfortable moving between detailed calculations, engineering documentation and the actual plant. ● Strong communicator who can work effectively across R&D, Engineering, Operations, suppliers and EPC partners. ● Fluent English; German is a plus. Why us? Our technology is moving from first-of-a-kind industrial operations toward increasingly larger and more standardized plants. The Senior Process Engineer will help us make that transition successfully: turning what we learn from today's plant into the engineering basis for tomorrow's plants while supporting commissioning and ramping up efforts. You will directly influence process performance, equipment selection, CAPEX and the technical architecture of our future facilities — helping ensure that every new scale is safer, simpler, more efficient and better engineered than the one before it. Bei Westernacher Consulting hast Du die Möglichkeit an großen, anspruchsvollen Projekten zusammen mit Top-Experten zu arbeiten. Deine Aufgaben als (Senior) SAP EWM Berater (w/m/d) Du begleitest unsere Kunden in nationalen und internationalen Projekten bei der Implementierung des SAP Extended Warehouse Management (EWM) Dazu gehört die Analyse der Kundenprozesse und die Konzeption sowie Implementierung (Customizing) von Lösungen auf Basis SAP EWM Du führst selbstständig Workshops und Prozessanalysen beim Kunden vor Ort durch Zudem erstellst Du fachliche und technische Spezifikationen für die Entwickler Je nach Komplexität des Projektes übernimmst Du eigenverantwortlich die (Teil-) Projektleitung eines Projektteams aus Beratern und Entwicklern Dein Profil Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung als Berater im SAP EWM Umfeld Du verfügst über einen Hochschulabschluss in BWL, (Wirtschafts-)Informatik, (Wirtschafts-) Ingenieurwesen, Logistik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation Kenntnisse in anderen SAP Logistikmodulen sind von Vorteil Du hast Lust und Kreativität, intelligente Lösungen für unsere Kunden zu erarbeiten Du möchtest Modul- und Projektverantwortung bis hin zu Managementaufgaben übernehmen Du bist reisebereit, auch für internationale Projekte Du verfügst über ausgezeichnete Deutsch- und gute Englischkenntnisse Das bieten wir Abwechslungsreiches und vielseitiges Aufgabengebiet mit vielen Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten in einem 100% Mitarbeiterunternehmen Die Möglichkeit an unserem Partnerschaftsmodell teilzunehmen Flachen Hierarchien, offene Kommunikation und ein internationales ambitioniertes Team aus erfahrenen SAP-Experten mit starkem Innovations- und Teamgeist Förderung Deiner Weiterentwicklung durch systematische Fortbildungen und Know-how-Austausch Flexible Arbeitszeiten, Home-Office und attraktive Vergütung Seit 1969 steht Westernacher Consulting für Innovation und globale Präsenz. Mit einem Team von über 1000 Beratern in Europa, Asien und Amerika bieten wir weltweit SAP-Beratungsdienstleistungen an. Unser Fokus liegt auf der Unterstützung von Groß- und Mittelstandsunternehmen, die nach Innovation, operativer Exzellenz und nachhaltigem Wachstum streben. Mit unserem Hauptsitz in Heidelberg, sind wir Vorreiter in der Innovation von Geschäftsprozessen und Technologien. Westernacher schätzt Vielfalt und Chancengleichheit am Arbeitsplatz. Wir berücksichtigen alle qualifizierten Bewerber unabhängig von ihrer Herkunft, Hautfarbe, Religion, Geschlecht, sexuellen Orientierung, Nationalität, genetischen Merkmalen, Behinderung, Alter oder Veteranenstatus. Zudem verpflichten wir uns, alle fairen Arbeitspraktiken in Bezug auf Staatsbürgerschaft und Einwanderungsstatus einzuhalten. #LI-IC1 Find Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

opportunities.title: Inside Sales Contractor
opportunities.description: About Us We are a financial services start up focusing on helping to improve consumer credit profiles. We are currently seeking KPI driven sales representatives looking to earn up to 45K in their first year while working remotely. We offer comprehensive training and continuous sales coaching to help you meet your financial goals. During our training period we offer a guaranteed training stipend while our trainees are acclimating to the position (*see weekly pay below). If you are a seasoned sales professional looking for the autonomy of a remote position combined with great compensation, we want to hear from you! Compensation Structure This role is 100% commission-based , which means your earning potential is unlimited. In addition, we regularly offer competitive performance-based bonuses to reward hard work and results. Training Period (Weeks 1–4) We invest in your success and want to make sure you’re supported as you get up to speed: Week 1: Commission-only (a chance to start earning right away while learning the ropes). Weeks 2–4: Guaranteed training stipend of $500 USD total – or your commission if it’s higher. You’ll always receive whichever amount benefits you most. Week 0: Unpaid Week 1: $100 guaranteed minimum Week 2: $150 guaranteed minimum Week 3: $250 guaranteed minimum By the end of training, you’ll have the skills to maximize commissions, with the safety net of a guaranteed base during your ramp-up period. Post Training Period: Average first year OTE: 25K-35K (US) Annually Top Rep first year OTE: 35K-45K (US) Annually *The above is the average pay you can expect, however, there is unlimited earning potential for those who are financially motivated top performers looking to exceed sales targets. What will you be doing? Educating inbound callers on their credit standing by providing consultations with the goal of enrolling them in one of our services should they be a good fit. We are looking for team members who are: Tech savvy with the ability to navigate digital tools such as SLACK, CRM software, google sheets, etc. Our team uses these digital tools daily. Growth oriented and always looking to learn and acquire new skills. Autonomous self starters who can work independently and efficiently. Team players with the ability to implement feedback from their sales coaches. Patient and professional with clients. Finances can be a difficult topic for some clients to discuss. We are looking for individuals who showcase empathy and professionalism especially under pressure! Financially motivated individuals who can meet and exceed sales targets. Outgoing with outstanding rapport building and active listening skills. Can you carry a conversation with anyone? This may be for you! You will need: Home office or a quiet place to work. Strong internet connection. Desktop or laptop (*Please Note: Devices such as Chromebooks, IPADs and laptops with 8G’s of RAM and under will have issues supporting our system) Scheduling Training: The schedule for the first four weeks of our training period is 10 AM - 6 PM EST. *The first week of training is mandatory for all new trainees. If a day is missed you may be asked to restart the first week of training. Post Training: We are currently seeking representatives to work on the following schedule: Monday - Friday Shift hours to be discussed with our hiring manager based on our company's needs at the time of hire. Shifts are as follows: 8:00 AM - 4:00 PM EST 8:30 AM - 4:30 PM EST 9:00 AM - 5:00 AM EST 9:30 AM - 5:30 PM EST 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM EST 10:30 AM - 6:30 PM EST 11:00 AM - 7:00 PM EST 11:30 AM - 7:30 PM EST 12:30 PM - 8:30 PM EST 1:30 PM - 9:30 PM EST 2:30 PM - 10:30 PM EST 3:00 PM - 11:00 PM EST Job Type: Contract Shift: 8 hour shift Day shift Evening shift Morning shift Night shift Supplemental Pay: Bonus opportunities Commission pay Experience: Sales: 1 year (Required) Work Location: Remote
